articles.title: Aave brings V3 lending and GHO stablecoin to Monad
articles.snippet: Aave launched its V3 lending protocol on Monad with 12 supported assets as the network commits $15 million in first-year incentives to build liquidity and adoption.

articles.title: Bitcoin price returns to $60K as US dollar strength rejects weekly high
articles.snippet: Bitcoin started July with a bang, rallying above $60,000 as traders predict a relief rally as the “base case” throughout the month.
